_note: Club promoters: a player job (Job Board, with an interview). Promoters run events at any venue, with bigger guest lists, and earn a commission for every guest who turns up. Numbers are mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_promoters.sql and checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs.

interview.q: A club gives you a guest list for Friday. The best way to fill it is to…
options: Spam everyone in the city with the same message
Invite people who'd love that night, personally, and get your regulars to bring friends
Promise free bottles you can't deliver

interview.q: Two of your guests start arguing at the door. You…
options: Stay calm, separate them and bring in venue security if needed

interview.q: A venue owner asks how your last event did. You…
options: Double the numbers to look good
Share the real numbers: who came, who came back, and what you'll do better
